limits_change: Operator decisions 2026-10-29: "I don't care about budget" and "expand the call cap to whatever the prime does in its benchmarks ... and the deadline". Prime's benchmark sources (pinned prime-agent c4c238ca: --autonomous-max-turns is optional and unset; research-environments ba10ef5a oolong_synth taskset: no turn, time or budget limit; Prime Agent blog: none stated) give no call cap or deadline. Limits are therefore set so they should not bind: 1000 calls and 1000 Aljure steps per session, 900 s safety deadline, 4 MiB requests (about the 1M-token window), 64 MiB task output, 200M tokens, $100 per arm. Model settings, prompts, tasks and scorer are unchanged.
opus_reservation_note: The gateway reserves 1,032,768 tokens at the highest input rate plus output per call: $8.66 for Opus, so one full reservation fits within each $12 arm cap. Calls are sequential in both harnesses here.
